outputs.explanation: Panel A is a schematic of breast anatomy plus a classification table; it contains no plot of averaged data.
Panel B is a schematic diagram illustrating the study aim; no quantitative plot is present.
Panel C is a schematic depicting the luciferase recording method; no data plot is shown.
Panel D shows illustrative line traces of circadian signals; line plots are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.
Panel E is a correlation heatmap; heatmaps are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.
Panel F contains an example line plot of cell number over time (growth dynamics); line plots are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.
Panel G contains an example dose-response line plot; line plots are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.
Panel H shows gene expression and mutation heatmaps; heatmaps are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.
Panel I shows PCA and 3D scatter plots where each dot already represents an individual sample/cell line, so no further overlay is needed.
